segments.text: Kimmy K3 is Moonshot's 2.8 trillion parameter multimodal model, 104 billion active, with a 1 million token context
and vision built into the architecture rather than bolted on. The weights are public under Moonshot's own license, not an OSI one. Open weights at this scale
is a strange phrase though since activating 104 billion parameters still means cluster hardware. So most people will reach it through the API.
